recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes the current FHIR-core application of FHIR-36401 by repairing the formal constraint references; any future result/qualifier/supplemental component-role model should be handled by a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-36401 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and asked that simple vital signs require either Observation.value[x] or Observation.dataAbsentReason, rather than allowing the measured result to be supplied only as an Observation.component, while leaving component role taxonomy as future consideration.
initial_application: The issue was applied through 2025 vital-signs profile commits: 67e77c9134 added the single-value invariant and Vital Signs Panel hasMember cardinality, d654aec30a moved the new constraints to the specific profile contexts, and af5373801d plus 51f56178b6 disambiguated vital-sign constraint names and value[x]/component.value[x] slicing. That left eight single-value profiles with invariant key vs-4 but element conditions referencing vsp-4.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/observation profile XML is current build input. FHIR-47136 and FHIR-23070 are related vital-sign profile cleanup issues; FHIR-42815, FHIR-44836, and FHIR-44721 are later or adjacent vital-sign issues already represented on the combined branch. Confluence minutes confirm the OO discussion and later block-vote trail for FHIR-36401, and direct Zulip search found no conflicting FHIR-36401 discussion.
reconciliation: Changed the invariant key from vs-4 to vsp-4 in BMI, body height, body temperature, body weight, head circumference, heart rate, oxygen saturation, and respiratory rate profiles. The FHIRPath expression and approved rule were not changed; the edit makes the existing condition references resolve to the intended invariant.
